title.narrative: Support strategic dialogue capacity building, knowledge exchange and youth engagement (PVW523ID06)

description.narrative: Implemented from November 2023 to October 2024, the project aimed to facilitate strategic dialogue and lay the groundwork for a multi-year inter-governmental capacity building programme in the water sector.The assignment supported the formulation of shared ambitions, thematic priorities and governance structures for long-term collaboration, aligning with strategic Indonesian development plans and mutual interests in areas such as nature-based solutions, urban water resilience, water governance and social inclusion. The project supported methodological preparation for the Joint Working Group Session of the Joint Steering Committee (JSC) and helped articulate jointly agreed deliverables, a roadmap and detailed planning to sustain strategic dialogue beyond the session.The contractor prepared and facilitated the strategic dialogue process, coordinated logistics, engaged relevant networks, integrated youth perspectives, and communicated effectively with stakeholders before and after the JSC event. Insights into Dutch water sector expertise were shared to enhance relevance and impact. Outcomes informed the outline of the multi-year programme, contributed to strengthened mutual understanding, and supported Indonesia–Netherlands cooperation in water capacity building and policy engagement.

title.narrative: Report: Contributions to a multi-year inter-governmental capacity-building outline within the framework of the MoU between Indonesia and The Netherlands on Water
